title: Warm Smoky Indian Chicken Curry
description: A smoky and springy Indian dish featuring taleggio cheese and mushimono-steam cooking method, perfect for midnight cravings. This low-glycemic-friendly recipe is a delicious and healthy option.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika, garam masala, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the saucepan and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add 1 cup of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the crumbled taleggio cheese until it is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
Use a steamer basket to steam the curry for 5 minutes, if desired, for a mushimono-steam effect.
